newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt slips despite in-line earnings.
newsitem.headline: Reckitt slips despite in-line earnings.

text.p: Shares in household products group Reckitt and Colman Plc halted their recent sharp advance on Thursday, after the group's pretax profits of 316.5 million stg did no more than meet average expectations.
The shares fell 17p to 772p by 0845 GMT.
Traders said Reckitt's 11 percent increase in profits was not enough to justify the high rating on the shares and a total dividend of 21.97p per share fell towards the lower end of expectations.
The company said economic conditions in Europe continued to be tough and sales overall were flat, although margins had improved.
"Profits were middle of the road of expectations," said one equity salesman. "They managed to meet the numbers but it's proving to be tough."
"We have to remember that Reckitt has had a cracking run recently."

The shares have risen by 14 percent in recent weeks, amid market rumours that the company may fall victim to a takeover bid by rival Unilever. But many analysts now think the bid premium makes the company too expensive as a takeover target.
